      .faq{padding:64px 0}.faq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;gap:70px}.faq h2{font-size:34px;margin:12px 0}.faq details{padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.faq summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.faq summary::after{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;flex:0 0 9px;border-right:2px solid var(--blue);border-bottom:2px solid var(--blue);transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-3px);transition:transform .2s ease}.faq details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(225deg) translate(-2px,-1px)}.faq p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}footer{padding:38px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
      /* Mobile-only layout. The approved desktop styles remain in index.html. */
      @media (max-width: 800px) {
        :host { --mobile-gutter: 20px; }
        :host { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
        .wrap { width: calc(100% - var(--mobile-gutter) * 2); }
        .eyebrow { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: .19em; }
        .btn { min-height: 48px; max-width: 100%; padding: 14px 18px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--navy); }
        .btn svg { flex: 0 0 16px; }
        .btn:hover { transform: none; }
        a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0072bc; outline-offset: 4px; }
        .cta a:focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
        header { height: 64px; }
        .nav { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 16px; }
        .nav .logo { min-height: 44px; }
        .nav nav, .nav > .btn { display: none; }
        .menu { display: grid; place-items: center; justify-self: end; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; }
        .menu svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
        .nav nav.open { position: absolute; top: 64px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 4px; padding: 12px var(--mobile-gutter) 16px; max-height: calc(100vh - 64px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 64px); overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 16px 28px rgba(0,52,90,.12); font-size: 14px; }
        .nav nav.open a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 0; }

        .hero { min-height: 0; }
        .hero-inner { display: block; min-height: 0; }
        .hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 4; min-height: 500px; max-width: none; padding: 32px 0 112px; }
        .hero-title { font-size: clamp(52px,15vw,68px); line-height: .9; margin: 12px 0 18px; }
        .hero h1 { max-width: 380px; font-size: clamp(29px,8vw,34px); line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .hero-copy p { max-width: 340px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #35516b; margin-bottom: 22px; }
        .hero-media { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 0 calc(-1 * var(--mobile-gutter)); width: auto; height: 100%; margin: 0; }
        .hero-media img { object-position: 69% 24%; }
        .hero-media:after { background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.95) 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.84) 52%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 80%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 100%); }
        .hero-note { top: auto; right: var(--mobile-gutter); bottom: 24px; max-width: min(210px,58vw); padding: 10px 20px 10px 12px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,42,72,.86) 0%,rgba(0,42,72,.64) 62%,rgba(0,42,72,.2) 87%,rgba(0,42,72,0) 100%); backdrop-filter: none; border-left-color: #76c6f2; color: #fff; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: .16em; font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,24,42,.6); }
        .grainline { display: none; }

        .problem { padding: 44px 0; }
        .problem-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 30px; }
        .problem h2 { font-size: clamp(27px,7.7vw,32px); line-height: 1.13; margin-top: 10px; }
        .problem h2 span { margin-top: 10px; }
        .compare { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 22px; align-items: start; }
        .compare > div { min-width: 0; }
        .compare-arrow { display: none; }
        .flow-label { margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 10px; }
        .flow { padding-left: 22px; }
        .flow:before { left: 5px; top: 22px; bottom: 22px; }
        .step { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; }
        .step:before { left: -21px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
        .step.hot { font-size: 14px; }
        .compare-note { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; padding-left: 14px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }

        .stats { padding: 44px 0; }
        .stats .eyebrow { display: block; margin-bottom: 24px; }
        .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 0 20px; }
        .stat { min-width: 0; padding: 22px 0; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
        .stat:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 0 0 24px; border: 0; }
        .stat strong { font-size: clamp(38px,11vw,46px); white-space: nowrap; }
        .stat:first-child strong { font-size: clamp(46px,13vw,60px); }
        .stat p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 10px; }
        .stat:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 20px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
        .stat:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; padding-bottom: 0; }
        .stat:last-child strong { font-size: 38px; }
        .stat:last-child p { margin: 0; }

        .how { padding: 44px 0 48px; }
        .how h2 { font-size: clamp(27px,7.7vw,32px); line-height: 1.15; margin: 10px 0 30px; }
        .timeline { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 0; }
        .timeline:before { left: 25px; right: auto; top: 26px; bottom: 26px; width: 2px; height: auto; }
        .node { min-width: 0; min-height: 90px; padding: 0 0 28px 72px; }
        .node:last-child { min-height: 52px; padding-bottom: 0; }
        .icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; left: 0; }
        .icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
        .node b { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.2; }
        .node p { max-width: 360px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 4px 0 0; }

        .ops { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); min-height: 0; }
        .ops-media { height: clamp(230px,66vw,350px); min-height: 0; }
        .ops-media img { object-position: 52% 56%; }
        .ops-label { left: var(--mobile-gutter); bottom: 20px; padding: 10px 24px 10px 12px; font-size: 9px; }
        .ops-copy { min-width: 0; padding: 36px var(--mobile-gutter) 44px; }
        .ops-copy h2 { font-size: clamp(27px,7.7vw,32px); line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.04em; margin-bottom: 24px; }
        .ops-copy h2 .ops-break { display: none; }
        .cargas { margin-bottom: 26px; }
        .cargas-label { margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .cargas ul { gap: 7px; }
        .cargas li { padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
        .benefits { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
        .benefit { padding: 18px 0; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
        .benefit:first-child { padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; }
        .benefit:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
        .benefit b { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .benefit p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 460px; }

        .rail { min-height: 460px; }
        .rail > img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-position: 24% 52%; }
        .rail-overlay { position: relative; min-height: 460px; padding: 32px 0; align-items: stretch; }
        .rail-overlay:after { background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,39,70,.86),rgba(0,39,70,.66) 28%,rgba(0,39,70,.13) 50%,rgba(0,39,70,.75) 76%,rgba(0,39,70,.9)); }
        .rail-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; align-items: stretch; gap: 96px; }

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ===================== CONFIGURACAO ===================== */

  /* Onde ficam as imagens. Troque pela pasta da Biblioteca de Midia da VLI
     quando as 9 imagens forem enviadas, mantendo a barra final. */
  var ASSETS = 'https://jobevieira.github.io/vli-preview/cargocif/assets/';

  /* URL que recebe o POST do formulario. Vazio = a pagina valida, confirma
     e avisa que nada foi enviado. Se o formulario virar um widget Form do
     Elementor, este bloco nao precisa mudar. */
  var FORM_ENDPOINT = '';

  /* ======================================================== */

  var FONTS = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap';
  var FALLBACK = {"terminal-cargocif-vli.webp": "terminal.webp", "rail-cargocif-vli.webp": "rail.webp", "cta-carregamento-vli.webp": "cta.webp"};

  /* @font-face so vale no documento, nunca dentro do shadow root. */
  function carregarFonte() {
    if (document.querySelector('link[data-cargocif-font]')) return;
    [['preconnect', 'https://fonts.googleapis.com', false],
     ['preconnect', 'https://fonts.gstatic.com', true],
     ['stylesheet', FONTS, false]].forEach(function (f) {
      var l = document.createElement('link');
      l.rel = f[0];
      l.href = f[1];
      if (f[2]) l.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      l.setAttribute('data-cargocif-font', '');
      document.head.appendChild(l);
    });
  }

  /* A largura da janela sem a barra de rolagem, para a secao ocupar a tela
     inteira mesmo dentro de um container estreito do Elementor. */
  function medir(host) {
    var w = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    host.style.setProperty('--cc-vw', w + 'px');
  }

  function montar(host) {
    if (host.shadowRoot) return;
    var tpl = host.querySelector('template[data-cargocif-template]');
    if (!tpl) return;

    var frag = tpl.content.cloneNode(true);

    /* Resolve os caminhos antes de entrar no DOM vivo: nenhuma requisicao 404. */
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(frag.querySelectorAll('img[src^="__ASSETS__"]'), function (img) {
      var nome = img.getAttribute('src').slice(10);
      img.src = ASSETS + nome;
      if (FALLBACK[nome]) {
        img.addEventListener('error', function trocar() {
          img.removeEventListener('error', trocar);
          img.src = ASSETS + FALLBACK[nome];
        });
      }
    });

    var raiz = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
    raiz.appendChild(frag);
    host.removeChild(tpl);

    carregarFonte();
    medir(host);
    var t;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      clearTimeout(t);
      t = setTimeout(function () { medir(host); }, 120);
    });

    ancoras(raiz);
    menu(raiz);
    formulario(raiz);
  }

  /* IDs vivem dentro do shadow root, entao o salto nativo nao os acha.
     O deslocamento repete o scroll-padding-top da pagina original. */
  function ancoras(raiz) {
    raiz.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!a) return;
      var alvo = raiz.querySelector('#' + CSS.escape(a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)));
      if (!alvo) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var suave = !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      var recuo = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 800px)').matches ? 80 : 88;
      var y = alvo.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - recuo;
      window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: suave ? 'smooth' : 'auto' });
    });
  }

  function menu(raiz) {
    var mb = raiz.querySelector('#menuBtn');
    var mn = raiz.querySelector('#mainnav');
    if (!mb || !mn) return;

    var abrir = function (open, devolverFoco) {
      mn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      mb.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      mb.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Fechar menu' : 'Abrir menu');
      if (devolverFoco) mb.focus();
    };

    mb.addEventListener('click', function () { abrir(mb.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(mn.querySelectorAll('a'), function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () { abrir(false); });
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && mb.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') abrir(false, true);
    });
    /* composedPath() enxerga dentro do shadow root; e.target, de fora, nao. */
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var caminho = e.composedPath ? e.composedPath() : [];
      if (caminho.indexOf(mn) === -1 && caminho.indexOf(mb) === -1) abrir(false);
    });
    window.matchMedia('(max-width: 800px)').addEventListener('change', function () { abrir(false); });
  }

  function formulario(raiz) {
    var form = raiz.querySelector('#leadForm');
    if (!form) return;

    var status = form.querySelector('.lead-status');
    var contador = raiz.querySelector('#lead-count');
    var msg = raiz.querySelector('#lead-mensagem');
    var enviar = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    var EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

    var campos = [
      { el: raiz.querySelector('#lead-nome'), err: raiz.querySelector('#err-nome'), ok: function (v) { return v.length >= 2; } },
      { el: raiz.querySelector('#lead-email'), err: raiz.querySelector('#err-email'), ok: function (v) { return EMAIL.test(v); } },
      { el: msg, err: raiz.querySelector('#err-mensagem'), ok: function (v) { return v.length >= 10; } }
    ];

    var marcar = function (f, valido) {
      f.el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(!valido));
      f.err.hidden = valido;
    };

    var contar = function () { contador.textContent = msg.value.length + '/' + msg.getAttribute('maxlength'); };
    msg.addEventListener('input', contar);
    contar();

    campos.forEach(function (f) {
      f.el.addEventListener('blur', function () { marcar(f, f.ok(f.el.value.trim())); });
      f.el.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (f.el.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') marcar(f, f.ok(f.el.value.trim()));
      });
    });

    var pronto = function (nome) {
      form.innerHTML = '<div class="lead-done"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'
        + '<h3>Contato registrado' + (nome ? ', ' + nome : '') + '.</h3>'
        + '<p>No site da VLI, esta mensagem segue para o time de CX e Comunicação, que direciona o contato ao especialista do CargoCIF.</p>'
        + (FORM_ENDPOINT ? '' : '<p>Esta é uma prévia para aprovação — nenhum dado foi enviado ou armazenado.</p>') + '</div>';
      var h = form.querySelector('h3');
      h.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
      h.focus();
    };

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      status.textContent = '';
      if (form.elements.site.value) return; /* armadilha anti-spam */

      var primeiro = null;
      campos.forEach(function (f) {
        var valido = f.ok(f.el.value.trim());
        marcar(f, valido);
        if (!valido && !primeiro) primeiro = f.el;
      });
      if (primeiro) {
        status.textContent = 'Revise os campos destacados.';
        primeiro.focus();
        return;
      }

      var nome = form.elements.nome.value.trim().split(' ')[0];
      if (!FORM_ENDPOINT) { pronto(nome); return; }

      enviar.disabled = true;
      fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT, { method: 'POST', body: new FormData(form), headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
        .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); pronto(nome); })
        .catch(function () {
          enviar.disabled = false;
          status.textContent = 'Não foi possível enviar agora. Tente novamente em instantes.';
        });
    });
  }

  function iniciar() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-cargocif-root]'), montar);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', iniciar);
  } else {
    iniciar();
  }
})();
</script>
